skill.name: internal-comms
skill.description: Creates structured internal communications using dedicated guidance for 3P updates, company newsletters, employee FAQs, and general announcements.
skill.summary: Draft clear internal updates in formats suited to teams, leaders, and company-wide audiences.
skill.author: Asmayaseen

security_audit.summary: All six static findings are false positives caused by ordinary prose and Markdown path delimiters. However, the newsletter workflow lacks explicit confidentiality and audience checks when aggregating internal sources, creating a medium information-disclosure risk.

remediation.issue: The newsletter workflow lacks confidentiality and audience controls for aggregated internal content.
remediation.suggestion: Require source authorization, confidentiality review, audience validation, and link-permission checks before including internal content in company-wide communications.

semantic_findings.title: Missing Confidentiality Controls for Internal Data Aggregation
semantic_findings.description: The newsletter workflow searches Slack, email, calendars, documents, and press, then republishes selected content company-wide. It does not require audience, confidentiality, or link-access checks before publication.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file explicitly directs broad collection and company-wide publication from internal systems. The risk comes from missing safeguards, although no malicious disclosure intent is stated.

content.value_statement: Internal updates often become inconsistent, lengthy, or unclear for their intended audience. This skill applies focused formats for concise updates, newsletters, FAQs, and announcements.
actual_capabilities: Selects a communication format based on the requested audience and purpose.
Formats weekly team updates into Progress, Plans, and Problems sections.
Structures company newsletters into themed sections with concise bullet points.
Turns common employee questions and official information into brief FAQ responses.
Drafts general announcements using audience, purpose, tone, and format requirements.
limitations: It does not provide direct Slack, email, calendar, or document integrations.
It cannot verify facts, metrics, source authority, or link permissions.
It requires user-provided context when connected company sources are unavailable.
It does not enforce confidentiality, retention, or audience access policies.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Weekly 3P Update
use_cases.description: Summarize completed work, next priorities, and blockers in a brief format for leadership review.

use_cases.title: Assemble a Company Newsletter
use_cases.description: Organize approved announcements, milestones, leadership updates, and external news into sections for company-wide distribution.

use_cases.title: Publish an Employee FAQ
use_cases.description: Convert recurring employee questions and official source material into concise answers with clear uncertainty labels.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a General Announcement
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a concise internal announcement about [topic] for [audience]. Use a [tone] tone and place the main action first.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the communication does not require a specialized format.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Weekly 3P Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a weekly 3P update for [team] covering [dates]. Use these facts: [progress, plans, problems]. Keep each section under three sentences.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a short team update sent to leaders or colleagues.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Employee FAQ
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these employee questions and official answers into a company FAQ: [materials]. Mark uncertainty and identify questions requiring executive confirmation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when employees need consistent answers about a change or event.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a Sourced Company Newsletter
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company newsletter for [period] from [approved sources]. Group 20 to 25 brief bullets by theme, preserve links, and exclude confidential material.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced company-wide summary based on reviewed source material.

output_examples.input: Create a 3P update for the Payments team for July 13 through July 19 using the supplied achievements, plans, and blockers.
output_examples.output:
Payments Team (July 13-19)
Progress: Released invoice reminders and reduced failed payment retries by 12 percent.
Plans: Complete regional tax testing and begin the billing portal pilot.
Problems: Vendor certification remains delayed, which may affect the pilot schedule.

output_examples.input: Draft an FAQ from approved leadership notes about the office access policy change.
output_examples.output:
Question: When does the new office access policy begin?
Answer: The policy begins August 3. Employees should review the official facilities notice for location-specific requirements.

Question: Who can approve an exception?
Answer: Managers may submit exception requests to People Operations. Final approval requirements remain under leadership review.

best_practices: Provide verified facts, exact dates, the target audience, and approved source links.
Mark uncertain information and identify the owner responsible for confirmation.
Review confidentiality, audience permissions, and link access before distribution.
anti_patterns: Do not invent metrics, decisions, quotations, or source links.
Do not combine unrelated audiences or excessive team detail in one update.
Do not include restricted information merely because the writer can access it.

faq.question: Which communication formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, company newsletters, employee FAQs, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, incident reports, and general announcements.

faq.question: Does this skill require access to company tools?
faq.answer: No. It can work from details you provide, while approved Slack, email, calendar, or document access may improve completeness.

faq.question: Can this skill send messages or publish newsletters?
faq.answer: No. It drafts content for review but does not send, post, or publish communications.

faq.question: What happens when important context is missing?
faq.answer: The skill asks for details such as the team, audience, time period, purpose, tone, and format.

faq.question: Can it match our company writing style?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide approved examples, terminology, and tone guidance so the draft can follow your established style.

faq.question: Does it protect confidential information automatically?
faq.answer: No. Review every draft for confidentiality, audience permissions, and link accessibility before distribution.
